events.verdict: Conley (MEM) sets the pick on Embiid (PHI) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Shamet (PHI) places his right forearm against Conley's (MEM) side and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR during the drive.
Gasol (MEM) makes incidental contact with Simmons (PHI) during the rebound.
Mack (MEM) places his arm around Redick (PHI) in the corner, but does not affect his FOM as they move toward the screen.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Redick (PHI) last touches the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Conley (MEM) extends his arm and makes slight contact with McConnell (PHI) that does not affect his ability to defend the inbound.
McConnell (PHI) briefly places his arms around Gasol (MEM) as the pick is set, but slides them off without affecting his FOM.
[Observable in enhanced video] Temple (MEM) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Gasol (MEM) makes marginal contact to McConnell's (PHI) backside in the post that does not affect his ability to defend.
Embiid (PHI) places his left arm to Gasol's (MEM) front and makes contact that affects his drive.
Conley (MEM) places his arm around Embiid's (PHI) leg during the pick and makes brief tactile contact.
Embiid (PHI) establishes himself in Conley's (MEM) defensive path during the re-screen and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Simmons (PHI) makes marginal contact to Conley's (MEM) leg during the driving shot attempt.
RAR shows Gasol (MEM) makes contact with his off-arm to McConnell's (PHI) head/neck area and affects his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Embiid (PHI) establishes himself in a screening position in Conley's (MEM) defensive path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
McConnell (PHI) trails Conley (MEM) during his dribble and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR.
Embiid (PHI) moves alongside and makes marginal contact with Gasol (MEM) during his dribble.
Gasol (MEM) gathers the ball and takes two legal steps.
Anderson (MEM) briefly holds Simmons' (PHI) arm as the shot is released but does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Anderson (MEM) sets the pick on Shamet (PHI) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Embiid (PHI) moves alongside Mack (MEM) in the lane and cleanly blocks his shot attempt.
Anderson (MEM) slightly extends his forearm into Shamet (PHI) but does not dislodge him during the rebound.
Conley (MEM) has his hand around Redick's (PHI) opposite side hip as they approach the screen, but it is a tactile touch that does not affect his FOM.
Embiid (PHI) and Gasol (MEM) briefly engage and disengage without affecting the other's FOM.
Gasol (MEM) makes contact with the ball during Redick's (PHI) jump shot attempt.
Mack (MEM) extends his forearm slightly against Shamet's (PHI) front during the inbound, but does not affect his ability to defend the play.
McConnell (PHI) moves alongside Conley (MEM) and places a hand against his off-arm during the dribble. This contact is marginal in nature and does not affect his SQBR.
Mack (MEM) places his left arm around Shamet's (PHI) midsection, but releases without affecting his FOM.
Embiid (PHI) establishes himself in a screening position after the dribble hand-off and gives Conley (MEM) room to avoid the contact.
McConnell (PHI) makes clean contact with the ball during the hand-off intended for Conley (MEM).
[Observable in enhanced video] RAR shows Conley (MEM) shuffles his feet after receiving the pass.
Gasol (MEM) establishes himself in McConnell's (PHI) path and is firming up when contact occurs on the screen.

The crew communicated with the Replay Center to determine who the ball went out of bounds off of. Initially, the ruling was Grizzlies' ball and after review, the ruling was the call stands as Grizzlies' ball.
Conley (MEM) wraps his right arm around Redick (PHI) near the perimeter.
Redick (PHI) sets the pick on Gasol (MEM) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Shamet (PHI) commits the take foul on Mack (MEM).
Embiid (PHI) commits the take foul on Conley (MEM).
Gasol (MEM) commits the intentional foul on Embiid (PHI).
